screening_criteria: Directly changes an analysis decision, interpretation, diagnostic or evidence-to-next-step workflow

limitations_and_corrections: GitHub counts/default branches are check-date snapshots, not validated quality indicators. Repository code was not executed or vendored.

pymc-labs/python-analytics-skills redirects to pymc-labs/pymc-modeling; current pinned SKILL.md reviewed, old broad catalogue not assumed current.

Benchopt README.md was absent; README.rst was retrieved and reviewed.
DABEST README license badge differs from API and source LICENSE; source LICENSE was inspected (Apache-2.0 at audited commit). No code reused.
Nature and some PMC direct opens encountered redirects, access blocks or CAPTCHA. PubMed metadata and available primary indexed excerpts used; not represented as complete full-text review.
P01 Statistical workflow: institution and publisher show different May 2026 days; only consistent year/volume/article number used.

BetterBench preprint/PDF and publication-page counts differ. No numerical count from these inconsistent versions was adopted into skill rules.
Two exploratory arXiv URL checks (2407.16711 and 2307.00271) resolved to different/unrelated works; not used as the intended benchmark/leakage evidence.
No comprehensive review, citation-impact ranking, independent replication of selected publications or independent LLM behavioral benchmark was performed. Access scopes are recorded in sources.md.
